# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class Form < Base
    def view_template(&)
      form(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          controller: "ruby-ui--form",
          action: "invalid->ruby-ui--form#focusFirstInvalid:capture"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormField < Base
    # shadcn targets Base UI's role=checkbox/radio buttons; RubyUI's are native inputs.
    ORIENTATIONS = {
      vertical: "flex-col *:w-full [&>.sr-only]:w-auto",
      horizontal: [
        "flex-row items-center has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:items-start *:data-[slot=field-label]:flex-auto",
        "has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:[&>input[type=checkbox],&>input[type=radio]]:mt-px"
      ].join(" "),
      responsive: [
        "flex-col *:w-full [&>.sr-only]:w-auto",
        "@md/field-group:flex-row @md/field-group:items-center @md/field-group:*:w-auto",
        "@md/field-group:has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:items-start @md/field-group:*:data-[slot=field-label]:flex-auto",
        "@md/field-group:has-[>[data-slot=field-content]]:[&>input[type=checkbox],&>input[type=radio]]:mt-px"
      ].join(" ")
    }.freeze

    def initialize(orientation: :vertical, **user_attrs)
      @orientation = orientation&.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "orientation must be one of #{ORIENTATIONS.keys.join(", ")}" unless ORIENTATIONS.key?(@orientation)

      super(**user_attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        data: {
          slot: "field",
          controller: "ruby-ui--form-field",
          orientation: @orientation
        },
        class: [
          "group/field flex w-full gap-3 data-[invalid=true]:text-destructive",
          ORIENTATIONS[@orientation]
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldContent < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-content"},
        class: "group/field-content flex flex-1 flex-col gap-1 leading-snug"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldError < Base
    # errors: strings or objects responding to #message (ActiveModel::Error),
    # e.g. user.errors[:email] or user.errors.where(:email). A block wins over
    # errors. The div is rendered even when empty: the FormField controller
    # writes client-side errors into it, and `empty:hidden` hides it meanwhile.
    def initialize(errors: nil, **user_attrs)
      @messages = Array(errors).map { |error| error.respond_to?(:message) ? error.message : error.to_s }
        .reject { |message| message.strip.empty? }
        .uniq

      super(**user_attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        if block
          yield
        elsif @messages.one?
          plain @messages.first
        elsif @messages.any?
          ul(class: "ml-4 flex list-disc flex-col gap-1") do
            @messages.each { |message| li { message } }
          end
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "alert",
        data: {
          slot: "field-error",
          ruby_ui__form_field_target: "error"
        },
        class: "empty:hidden text-sm font-normal text-destructive"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldGroup < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-group"},
        class: [
          "group/field-group @container/field-group flex w-full flex-col gap-7",
          "data-[slot=checkbox-group]:gap-3 *:data-[slot=field-group]:gap-4"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldHint < Base
    def view_template(&)
      p(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "field-description",
          ruby_ui__form_field_target: "hint"
        },
        class: [
          "empty:hidden text-left text-sm leading-normal font-normal text-muted-foreground",
          # shadcn's last:mt-0 nth-last-2:-mt-1, counting siblings as if an
          # empty FormFieldError (always rendered here, never in shadcn) were absent.
          # Right after a legend they step aside, so the legend rule wins as in shadcn.
          "[&:nth-last-child(1_of_:not([data-slot=field-error]:empty)):not([data-variant=legend]+*)]:mt-0",
          "[&:nth-last-child(2_of_:not([data-slot=field-error]:empty)):not([data-variant=legend]+*)]:-mt-1",
          "[[data-variant=legend]+&]:-mt-1.5",
          "[&>a]:underline [&>a]:underline-offset-4 [&>a:hover]:text-primary"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldLabel < Base
    def view_template(&)
      label(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-label"},
        class: [
          "empty:hidden flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm leading-snug font-medium select-none",
          "group-data-[disabled=true]/field:pointer-events-none group-data-[disabled=true]/field:opacity-50",
          "peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-disabled:opacity-50",
          "peer-aria-disabled:cursor-not-allowed peer-aria-disabled:opacity-50 peer-aria-disabled:pointer-events-none",
          # A label wrapping a FormField becomes a selectable card (shadcn's
          # has-data-checked maps to native :checked).
          "has-[>[data-slot=field]]:w-full has-[>[data-slot=field]]:flex-col has-[>[data-slot=field]]:rounded-md has-[>[data-slot=field]]:border *:data-[slot=field]:p-3",
          "has-[>[data-slot=field]]:not-has-[:disabled,[data-disabled]]:hover:bg-muted/50",
          "has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-visible]:border-ring has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-visible]:ring-3 has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50",
          "has-checked:border-primary/30 has-checked:bg-primary/5 dark:has-checked:border-primary/20 dark:has-checked:bg-primary/10"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldLegend < Base
    VARIANTS = %i[legend label].freeze

    def initialize(variant: :legend, **user_attrs)
      @variant = variant&.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "variant must be one of #{VARIANTS.join(", ")}" unless VARIANTS.include?(@variant)

      super(**user_attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      legend(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-legend", variant: @variant},
        class: "mb-3 font-medium data-[variant=label]:text-sm data-[variant=legend]:text-base"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldSeparator < Base
    def view_template(&block)
      div(**mix(attrs, data: {content: block ? "true" : "false"})) do
        render RubyUI::Separator.new(decorative: false, class: "absolute inset-0 top-1/2")
        if block
          span(
            data: {slot: "field-separator-content"},
            class: "relative mx-auto block w-fit bg-background px-2 text-muted-foreground",
            &block
          )
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-separator"},
        class: "relative -my-2 h-5 text-sm group-data-[variant=outline]/field-group:-mb-2"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldSet < Base
    def view_template(&)
      fieldset(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-set"},
        class: "flex flex-col gap-6 has-[>[data-slot=checkbox-group]]:gap-3 has-[>[data-slot=radio-group]]:gap-3"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class FormFieldTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    # Shares the field-label slot with FormFieldLabel, as in shadcn, so a
    # horizontal FormField stretches it the same way.
    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "field-label"},
        class: "flex w-fit items-center gap-2 text-sm leading-snug font-medium group-data-[disabled=true]/field:opacity-50"
      }
    end
  end
end

# Form

Building forms with built-in client-side validations.

## Usage

### Example

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "default_error") { "Default error" }
    Input(id: "default_error", placeholder: "Joel Drapper", required: true, minlength: "3") { "Joel Drapper" }
    FormFieldHint()
    FormFieldError()
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```

### Disabled

```ruby
FormField(data: {disabled: "true"}) do
  FormFieldLabel(for: "disabled") { "Disabled" }
  Input(id: "disabled", disabled: true, placeholder: "Joel Drapper", required: true, minlength: "3") { "Joel Drapper" }
end
```

### Aria Disabled

```ruby
FormField(data: {disabled: "true"}) do
  FormFieldLabel(for: "aria_disabled") { "Aria Disabled" }
  Input(id: "aria_disabled", aria: {disabled: "true"}, placeholder: "Joel Drapper", required: true, minlength: "3") { "Joel Drapper" }
end
```

### Custom error message

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "custom_error_message") { "Custom error message" }
    Input(id: "custom_error_message", placeholder: "joel@drapper.me", required: true, data_value_missing: "Custom error message")
    FormFieldError()
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```

### Backend error

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "backend_error") { "Backend error" }
    Input(id: "backend_error", placeholder: "Joel Drapper", required: true)
    FormFieldError { "Error from backend" }
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```

### Multiple errors

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "multiple_errors") { "Username" }
    Input(id: "multiple_errors", value: "j!", required: true)
    # e.g. FormFieldError(errors: user.errors[:username])
    FormFieldError(errors: ["is too short (minimum is 3 characters)", "only allows letters and numbers"])
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```

### Checkbox

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField(orientation: :horizontal) do
    Checkbox(id: "accept_terms", required: true)
    FormFieldLabel(for: "accept_terms") { "Accept terms and conditions" }
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```

### Fieldset

```ruby
FormFieldSet(class: "w-2/3") do
  FormFieldLegend { "Address information" }
  FormFieldHint { "We need your address to deliver your order." }
  FormFieldGroup do
    FormField do
      FormFieldLabel(for: "fieldset_street") { "Street address" }
      Input(id: "fieldset_street", placeholder: "123 Main St")
    end
    FormField do
      FormFieldLabel(for: "fieldset_city") { "City" }
      Input(id: "fieldset_city", placeholder: "New York")
    end
  end
end
```

### Horizontal with description

```ruby
FormField(orientation: :horizontal, class: "w-2/3") do
  Checkbox(id: "horizontal_newsletter")
  FormFieldContent do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "horizontal_newsletter") { "Subscribe to the newsletter" }
    FormFieldHint { "One email a month, no spam." }
  end
end
```

### Responsive

```ruby
FormFieldGroup do
  FormField(orientation: :responsive) do
    FormFieldContent do
      FormFieldLabel(for: "responsive_name") { "Name" }
      FormFieldHint { "Side by side on wide containers, stacked on narrow ones." }
    end
    Input(id: "responsive_name", placeholder: "Joel Drapper")
  end
end
```

### Choice card

```ruby
FormFieldGroup(class: "w-2/3") do
  FormFieldLabel(for: "plan_starter") do
    FormField(orientation: :horizontal) do
      FormFieldContent do
        FormFieldTitle { "Starter" }
        FormFieldHint { "For small teams getting started." }
      end
      RadioButton(id: "plan_starter", name: "plan", value: "starter", checked: true)
    end
  end
  FormFieldLabel(for: "plan_pro") do
    FormField(orientation: :horizontal) do
      FormFieldContent do
        FormFieldTitle { "Pro" }
        FormFieldHint { "For growing teams that need more." }
      end
      RadioButton(id: "plan_pro", name: "plan", value: "pro")
    end
  end
end
```

### Separator

```ruby
FormFieldGroup(class: "w-2/3") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "separator_email") { "Email" }
    Input(id: "separator_email", type: "email", placeholder: "joel@example.com")
  end
  FormFieldSeparator { "Or" }
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel(for: "separator_phone") { "Phone" }
    Input(id: "separator_phone", type: "tel", placeholder: "+1 555 0100")
  end
end
```

### Select

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel { "Select" }
    Select do
      SelectInput(required: true)
      SelectTrigger do
        SelectValue(placeholder: "Select a fruit")
      end
      SelectContent() do
        SelectGroup do
          SelectLabel { "Fruits" }
          SelectItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
          SelectItem(value: "orange") { "Orange" }
          SelectItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
          SelectItem(value: "watermelon") { "Watermelon" }
        end
      end
    end
    FormFieldError()
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```

### Combobox

```ruby
Form(class: "w-2/3 space-y-6") do
  FormField do
    FormFieldLabel { "Combobox" }

    Combobox(name: "food", required: true) do
      ComboboxTrigger { ComboboxValue(placeholder: "Pick value") }

      ComboboxContent do
        ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Search", show_trigger: false)
        ComboboxEmpty { "No result" }

        ComboboxList do
          ComboboxGroup do
            ComboboxLabel { "Fruits" }
            ComboboxItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
            ComboboxItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
          end
          ComboboxSeparator()
          ComboboxGroup do
            ComboboxLabel { "Vegetable" }
            ComboboxItem(value: "brocoli") { "Broccoli" }
            ComboboxItem(value: "carrot") { "Carrot" }
          end
          ComboboxSeparator()
          ComboboxGroup do
            ComboboxLabel { "Others" }
            ComboboxItem(value: "chocolate") { "Chocolate" }
            ComboboxItem(value: "milk") { "Milk" }
          end
        end
      end
    end

    FormFieldError()
  end
  Button(type: "submit") { "Save" }
end
```
